As of now, the only thing giving Trump a boost in the polls is that company that writes the number 5 on gas station price signs," the host of *The Daily Show* said, as footage showed gas prices above five dollars a gallon. "Business is booming!"

According to data from the American Automobile Association (AAA), average regular gasoline prices in California, Hawaii, Washington and Oregon have all exceeded five dollars.

The comedy show cited reports saying Trump's disapproval rating has climbed to 64%.

Guesta sarcastically scolded Americans for being too "unwilling to let go."

"You know, losing a war, crashing an economy," he added, "getting food poisoning so bad you crap yourself in seven colors — you still have to let go."
